REFERRAL LETTER
Date: 10/13/2026
Patient Name: Marcus Lewis
DOB: 06/04/1968
MRN: MRN-45861

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Henry Reed, Green Valley Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of an episode of fainting.

Marcus Lewis is a 58-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism. He briefly lost consciousness while standing in his kitchen, awoke within a minute, and felt tired afterward. He reports no injury or recurrence.

Please assess this episode of fainting and advise on further evaluation and care.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Henry Reed
Green Valley Family Practice

SUBJECTIVE:
Marcus Lewis is a 58-year-old male seen for routine follow-up of hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism. He reports doing well and taking his prescribed treatment consistently, without adverse effects. He is working on maintaining a balanced diet and regular activity.

VITALS:
BP 127/94, HR 73, RR 16, SpO2 96% on room air, weight 188 lb.

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, grade 2/6 systolic ejection murmur, no radiation.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN:
1. Hypertension is stable by history. Continue the established treatment plan and reinforce dietary measures and regular activity.
2. Type 2 diabetes mellitus is stable by history. Continue the established treatment plan and reinforce dietary consistency and regular activity.
3. Hypothyroidism is stable by history. Continue the established treatment plan and monitor for changes in energy or other symptoms.
